title: core: type-graph assembly + feature slice (types.rs, feature.rs)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W2]
Seats: CORE-05, CORE-06
crates/core/src/types.rs: assemble TypeNode/TypeEdge into a queryable graph (by file, by module, repo-wide) with helper lookups the GUI/CLI need (fields of, methods of, edges filtered by kind) (F2c). crates/core/src/feature.rs: feature slice — `slice(idx, entrypoint, depth) -> FeatureSlice` reusing core::flow waves but returning an ORDERED call tree with per-node call line + confidence, deduped and cycle-safe (F2b). Both consume frozen contracts (analysis.rs, flow.rs). Owner: crates/core/src/{types,feature}.rs + lib.rs lines. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core (inline: type edges on a fixture, slice depth/order/cycle-safe).

EVIDENCE (CORE-05/06, batch B2):
Files: crates/core/src/types.rs (build() + node/in_file/edges_of/edges_of_kind + supertypes/subtypes, 4 tests); crates/core/src/feature.rs (slice() ordered/deduped/cycle-safe BFS carrying name/line/depth, 8 tests). No other file touched.
cargo fmt --all -- --check -> exit 0 for both files (only remaining tree diff is analyze/python.rs owned by INTEL-3).
cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0, no warnings.
cargo test -p repowalk-core -> lib 115 passed/0 failed (types+feature contribute 12); integration export_emitters 10, contract 6, grammar_abi 4, analysis_golden 3, walk_metrics 2, golden 1, zz_scratch_counts 1; 0 doctests; 0 failed anywhere.
types::build: nodes keep analysis.types order; an edge is dropped when either endpoint is not a declared node; exact (from,to,kind,line) duplicates collapse to the first occurrence. Query helpers answer node/in_file/edges_of/edges_of_kind; added Inherit-only supertypes/subtypes.
feature::slice ordering rule (GUI contract): entry first at depth 0 with line 0; then one step per newly-reached symbol, layer by layer (BFS depth ascending); within a layer sorted by (call-site line, symbol id). Each step carries symbol id, name (Index::symbols lookup; raw callee as fallback), reaching call line, depth. Deduped: a symbol appears once, at its shallowest depth. Cycle-safe via a seen-set; never panics on empty index / unknown entry (None) / self-recursion / 2-cycle / depth 0 / huge depth.
Documented filtering (in the module doc comment): only EdgeKind::Call edges are traversed; Confidence::Unresolved is skipped because it names no known symbol (resolve.rs keeps the raw callee there) and would fabricate nodes. Exact/NameOnly/Ambiguous are all walked; when several edges reach one symbol the smallest call line wins, ties break toward higher confidence then lexicographically smaller parent. Name-keyed callers are canonicalized to ids exactly as flow::CallGraph::caller_key; flow.rs was NOT edited (frozen, owned elsewhere) — its waves() sorts layers lexicographically and drops line+confidence, so it cannot express this contract.
GRAPH-5 note: rely on ordered FeatureSlice.steps; each tuple (symbol, name, line, depth) is stable for a fixed Index.
